content.scenario: A consumer protection agency, after investigating a complaint, found a business guilty of unfair trade practices for the second time within a year. The business had previously been convicted of a similar offence six months ago.
content.outcome: The court, as per the provisions of the Consumer Protection Act, 2019, cancelled the business's licence due to the second conviction, effectively shutting down their operations.
